policy: Reviewed serializations are separated from unresolved debt. Exact full-source and caller locks fail closed on any edit. Raw AST shape counts remain visible; no new unresolved debt is permitted.

entries.why: READ COMMITTED saveDraft takes a question-key advisory lock before checking draft/attribution, plus a round ordinal lock before MAX+1. seal takes the exclusive round lock before reading answers; clarify/seal.ts opens the caller transaction. Regressions: rfc395-clarify-target-concurrency.test.ts. RFC-400: reviewed the seal.ts change (the task node-status event is appended through the injected task-execution participant on the same tx); the round lock, the caller transaction and the answer insert order remain unchanged. RFC-442: reviewed the seal.ts change (setNodeClarifyDirectiveTx is imported from the sibling infrastructure module instead of the deleted services/taskClarifyDirective re-export; same function); the round lock, the caller transaction and the answer insert order remain unchanged. RFC-454: reviewed the seal.ts change (sealAnswersServerSide, reconcileRoundEntriesTx and wgClarifyAskerKeyForRound are imported from their collaboration declarations instead of the deleted services/ re-exports; the asker key moved verbatim into collaboration domain); the round lock, the caller transaction and the answer insert order remain unchanged. RFC-482: reviewed the seal.ts change (the human-gate persistence participant and the in-transaction stop-directive write come from the participant bindings — the same task-execution factories, built on the same transaction — instead of task-execution's public entry and the deleted collaboration directive forwarder); the round lock, the caller transaction and the answer insert order remain unchanged. RFC-485: reviewed the seal.ts change (the task-gate read inside the seal transaction comes from the participant bindings — the same task-execution factory, built on the same transaction — instead of task-execution's public entry); the round lock, the caller transaction and the answer insert order remain unchanged. RFC-537: reviewed the seal.ts change (the post-commit publish passes args.db, the database the seal transaction committed on, so the after-commit pump comes from that handle instead of a process-level registration; it still runs after the transaction); the round lock, the caller transaction and the answer insert order remain unchanged.

replaceOutputs uses withTaskExecutionWrite (READ COMMITTED), then fencedTaskId: owner fence -> task root -> node-run lock, before reading/deleting/inserting outputs for that nodeRunId. Regressions: rfc395-run-write-atomicity.test.ts. RFC-397: reviewed the session-helper comment change; owner/task/run lock protocol and output replacement remain unchanged.
